professional_identity.professional_summary: Pradeep Selladurai is a Cyber Security undergraduate focused on AI Engineering. He currently works on AI and AI-agent projects at Elverve while also building and experimenting with AI systems independently. His technical focus includes Agentic AI, Voice AI, Context Engineering, real-time AI systems, agent orchestration, deterministic workflows, FSM-based orchestration, MCP, RAG, and LLM applications. He learns by building, researching, testing ideas, debugging limitations, and improving implementations.

career_journey.why_cyber_security: After completing higher secondary education, I selected Cyber Security because it appeared to be an exciting and growing field. At that time I did not have complete clarity about my long-term career path.
career_journey.ai_discovery: During my second year of engineering I started exploring Artificial Intelligence and became increasingly interested in how intelligent systems work.
career_journey.transition_to_ai: During my third year I joined Elverve and started working on AI and AI-agent projects. The work exposed me to practical AI development, real-time systems, agent orchestration, Voice AI, context engineering, and the challenges involved in building useful AI systems. This shifted my primary career direction toward AI Engineering.
career_journey.current_direction: I am currently focused on becoming an AI Engineer. My strongest areas are Agentic AI, Voice AI, Context Engineering, real-time AI systems, agent orchestration, and practical LLM application development. I am also researching how agent loops, agent harnesses, deterministic orchestration, FSMs, MCP, and model behavior fit into real AI systems.

learning_style.learning_philosophy: Build -> Break -> Debug -> Research -> Improve -> Build Again
learning_style.description: I prefer learning through practical implementation rather than only studying theory. I enjoy building systems, identifying limitations, debugging issues, researching solutions, and continuously improving my implementations.
